mods.title: [EMF] Entity Model Features
mods.why: EMF: required for Fresh Animations (no OptiFine).

mods.title: [ETF] Entity Texture Features
mods.why: ETF: required for Fresh Animations and emissives.

mods.title: Subtle Effects
mods.why: Configurable ambient polish (fireflies, sparks, steam, dust, biome particles). Weather particles stay with Particle Rain; overlapping options are disabled in config.

mods.title: Sound Controller
mods.why: Sound Controller: per-sound volume control for overlapping sound mods.

mods.title: Auto Third Person
mods.why: Auto Third Person: camera while riding/swimming/gliding.

mods.title: Punchy! Moves
mods.why: Punchy Moves: first-person attack animations (beta). Fluid & Foolish (its required animation pack) is installed as a resource pack.

mods.title: Seamless Sleep
mods.why: Seamless Sleep: smooth time passage while sleeping.

mods.title: Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge
mods.why: Bosses of Mass Destruction (existing NeoForge port).

mods.title: The Aether
mods.why: Sky dimension with three dungeon bosses and its own gear line.

mods.title: Deeper and Darker
mods.why: Otherside dimension beyond Ancient Cities; Warden-tier progression.

mods.title: The Bumblezone - NeoForge/Forge
mods.why: Unique bee dimension with its own challenge/quest-like progression.

mods.title: The Undergarden
mods.why: Underground dimension with a boss and its own material tier.

mods.title: Better Clouds
mods.why: Better Clouds: Sodium/Iris-aware cloud renderer. Profile-controlled.

mods.title: Cave Dust Rethinking
mods.why: Cave Dust: underground dust particles; owns cave dust (Subtle Effects equivalent off).

mods.title: ClearDespawn Reborn
mods.why: Clear Despawn: items blink before despawning.

mods.title: Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
mods.why: Cozy Critters & Creepy Crawlies: client-side ambient critters. Profile-controlled density.

mods.title: Effectual
mods.why: Effectual: ambient particles; overlapping Subtle Effects categories disabled.

mods.title: FootprintParticle
mods.why: Footprint Particle: footprints on soft blocks. Profile-controlled.

mods.title: Fancy World Animations [FWA]
mods.why: Fancy World Animations: block open/close animations. Lantern swing owned by Swinging Lanterns.

mods.title: Inventory Particles
mods.why: Inventory Particles: particles on item interactions in GUIs.

mods.title: Interactive Foliage
mods.why: Interactive Foliage: plants bend around entities (needs Sway).

mods.title: Visual Overhaul
mods.why: Visual Overhaul: model polish for vanilla blocks/items.

mods.title: Visuality: Reforged
mods.why: Visuality: hit/crystal/water-splash particles. Ambient-particle overlap with Subtle Effects resolved in config.

mods.title: Ars Nouveau
mods.why: Utility/automation magic: glyph spells, mana, rituals, item transport.

mods.title: Iron's Lib
mods.why: Iron's Spells requires irons_lib >=1.21.1-2 <1.21.1-3 (undeclared in Modrinth metadata; found by launch test).

mods.title: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
mods.why: Combat magic: schools, spellbooks, scroll loot, boss encounters.

mods.title: Occultism
mods.why: Spirit-based automation and storage; ritual crafting.

mods.title: Entity Culling
mods.why: Skips rendering hidden entities/block entities - important with large factories.

mods.title: Lithium
mods.why: Server-tick optimisations (AI, collisions, chunk ticking). NeoForge build.

mods.title: ModernFix
mods.why: Load time and memory reduction; biggest single win for large packs.

mods.title: Corpse
mods.why: Death recovery: items stay in a corpse at the death spot (also for void deaths) instead of despawning, so dying costs a trip back, not the whole kit.

mods.title: EMI
mods.why: Primary recipe viewer with recipe trees.

mods.title: Farmer's Delight
mods.why: Food variety that makes survival more than bread.

mods.title: Just Enough Items (JEI)
mods.why: Loads JEI-only plugins (Create, etc.); EMI hides JEI's UI.

mods.title: Lootr
mods.why: Per-player structure loot: each player opens their own copy of every structure container, so the expedition reward budget (docs/LOOT.md) holds per player in multiplayer instead of first-come-first-served.

mods.title: Odyssey Quests
mods.why: Quest book (Heracles). FTB Quests is CurseForge-only and cannot be in an .mrpack.

mods.title: Polymorph
mods.why: Resolves recipe output conflicts between mods.

mods.title: Waystones
mods.why: Discoverable fast travel - must be found in villages/structures.

mods.title: Forgified Fabric API
mods.why: Fabric API surface required by Roxy/Voxy.

mods.title: Reese's Sodium Options
mods.why: Usable video settings UI for Sodium's expanded option set.

mods.title: Roxy
mods.why: Translation layer that runs the original Voxy jar on NeoForge 1.21.1.

mods.title: Sodium
mods.why: Renderer foundation required by Roxy/Voxy and Iris.

mods.title: Sodium Extra
mods.why: Extra Sodium toggles used by the Performance profile (particles, animations, fog).

mods.title: voxy
mods.why: Long-distance LOD renderer. Roxy's only verified jar: voxy-0.2.16-beta for MC 1.21.11 (loaded through Roxy, not natively).

mods.title: Voxygen
mods.why: Generates real chunks in the background and feeds them to Voxy, so distant LODs match the modded terrain exactly (no seed approximation). Roxy ships compat for this v2 line.

mods.title: Apotheosis
mods.why: Core loot system: affixes, rarities, gems, sockets, world tiers, bosses.

mods.title: Apothic Attributes
mods.why: Attribute framework used by Apotheosis (crit, armor pierce, etc.).

mods.title: Apothic-Enchanting
mods.why: Enchanting overhaul; gives enchanting long-term depth.

mods.title: Gateways to Eternity
mods.why: Bounded, readable wave challenges (fixed waves, fixed entity counts, visible timer). Activates the gateway data Apotheosis already ships and hosts Horizon's late-game Trials, which consume exploration relics instead of producing them.

mods.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm
mods.why: Late-game structure bosses with progression-defining drops.

mods.title: Mowzie's Mobs
mods.why: Mid-game overworld mini-bosses that make exploring dangerous.

mods.title: Relics
mods.why: Levelling relics found in structures (rare/legendary loot).

mods.title: ShatterLib | OctoLib
mods.why: Provides mod id 'octolib' required by Relics 0.10.x (undeclared in Modrinth metadata; found by launch test).

mods.title: Simply Swords
mods.why: Weapon variety with unique uniques; Better Combat movesets built in.

mods.title: Dungeons and Taverns
mods.why: Uncommon tier: taverns, illager hideouts, ancient ruins.

mods.title: Explorify
mods.why: Common/uncommon tier: small vanilla-styled ruins, camps and shrines.

mods.title: Repurposed Structures - Neoforge/Forge
mods.why: Biome-matched variants of vanilla structures; very configurable rarity.

mods.title: Structory
mods.why: Common tier: atmospheric ruins and minor discoveries.

mods.title: Towns and Towers
mods.why: Settlements and pillager outposts with regional variety.

mods.title: When Dungeons Arise
mods.why: Rare/legendary tier: huge hand-built dungeons and landmarks.

mods.title: Applied Energistics 2
mods.why: Digital storage and autocrafting across all tech mods.

mods.title: Applied Mekanistics
mods.why: Official AE2 storage/autocrafting of Mekanism chemicals.

mods.title: CC: Tweaked
mods.why: Programmable computers/turtles; CC tags its stable line as beta.

mods.title: Create: Enchantment Industry
mods.why: Liquid XP + automated enchanting; ties Create to Apotheosis enchanting.

mods.title: Create Crafts & Additions
mods.why: Bridges Create rotational power and FE electricity.

mods.title: MEGA Cells
mods.why: MEGA Cells: late-game AE2 storage tiers.

mods.title: Mekanism
mods.why: Ore multiplication, chemistry, jetpacks/MekaSuit - the mid-game processing pillar.

mods.title: Mekanism Generators
mods.why: Mekanism power line up to fission/fusion.

mods.title: Modern Industrialization
mods.why: Deep multiblock industrial progression (steam -> electric -> fusion).

mods.title: Powah!
mods.why: Mid-game FE generation tiers, simple to learn.

mods.title: Last World Panorama
mods.why: Last World Panorama: title panorama from the last world.

mods.title: TW‘s  Decorative Food
mods.why: TW's Decorative Food: placeable food decor.

mods.title: MMR - Moog's Mineshafts Reimagined
mods.why: Moog's Mineshafts Reimagined (overlaps YUNG's Better Mineshafts; see COMPATIBILITY.md).

mods.title: Streams Reflowing
mods.why: Streams Reflowing: flowing streams worldgen. New chunks only.

mods.title: Incendium Legacy
mods.why: Nether biome + structure overhaul (Stardust Labs). Only 1.21.1 build is tagged alpha upstream; smoke-tested.

mods.title: Nullscape
mods.why: End terrain overhaul (Stardust Labs) - gives the End exploration value.

mods.title: Tectonic
mods.why: Terrain shaping: huge mountain ranges, deep valleys, rivers; officially Terralith-compatible.

mods.title: Terralith
mods.why: Biome foundation: ~95 vanilla-block biomes, cave biomes, works with vanilla tooling and Voxy's server-side LOD build.

shaders.why: Default shader. Voxy support since r5.8.1. r5.9.3 chosen over r5.10 (3 days old).

resourcepacks.title: Fresh Animations: Extensions
resourcepacks.why: Official FA extensions bundle; individual components NOT installed (duplicates).

resourcepacks.title: Fresh Animations: Player Compats
resourcepacks.why: Conditional FA player patches (Artifacts, Farmers Delight present).

resourcepacks.title: Fluid & Foolish
resourcepacks.why: Required animation pack for Punchy Moves (separate from FA mob stack).
